2609.10892.title: DriftNet: A Dual-Head Trajectory Transformer for Detecting and Localizing Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
2609.10892.paper_summary: When an indirect prompt injection succeeds against an LLM agent, the compromise is visible in the agent's own behavior: a benign prefix of tool calls, a poisoned observation, and a suffix of actions that serve the attacker. An operator needs three facts: where the attack entered, which steps it corrupted, and whether apparent poison was resisted. Existing systems return either a whole-trace verdict or a single unsafe index. We present DriftNet, a dual-head trajectory Transformer that reads a logged tool-call trajectory and answers all three questions in one forward pass: one head classifies the trajectory as compromised or not, and a second assigns every step one of four labels (benign, injection point, hijacked, failed injection). To our knowledge it is the first supervised detector to produce this joint output. A frozen sentence encoder and four identity-free world features embed each step; the trained trunk, under two million parameters and optimized with a class-weighted joint objective over both heads, needs no access to the agent's model. On the task-disjoint split of the AgentDrift benchmark (12,536 trajectories, 71,024 labeled steps), with a 20-configuration sweep bounding hyperparameter sensitivity to 0.011 F1 and the test part evaluated exactly once, DriftNet reaches trajectory-level F1 of 0.983, exact injection-point recovery on 98.7% of attacked trajectories, hijacked-span IoU of 0.979, zero flags on 218 resisted attacks, and 2.9% flags on hard negatives. A surface baseline retrained on the identical split recovers 11.1% of partial hijacks and 17.1% of delayed executions; DriftNet reaches 98.6% and 93.2% while lowering every false-alarm rate. Reading all 26 residual errors shows that most misses trace to trajectories whose labeled injection observation carries no legible instruction, and we report the benchmark's measured world-identity regularity alongside the results.
2609.10892.paper_summary_zh: 當間接提示注入成功影響 LLM 代理時，妥協在代理自身的行為中可見：一個無害的工具調用前綴、一個被污染的觀察，以及一個服務於攻擊者的行動後綴。操作員需要三個事實：攻擊進入的位置、被破壞的步驟，以及是否抵抗了明顯的毒素。現有系統返回整個追蹤的判決或單一不安全指數。我們提出 DriftNet，一個雙頭軌跡Transformer，它讀取記錄的工具調用軌跡並在一次前向傳遞中回答所有三個問題：一個頭將軌跡分類為妥協或未妥協，第二個頭為每個步驟分配四個標籤之一（無害、注入點、劫持、注入失敗）。據我們所知，它是第一個產生此聯合輸出的監督檢測器。一個凍結的句子編碼器和四個無身份特徵嵌入每個步驟；訓練的主幹在兩百萬個參數之下，並通過對兩個頭的類別加權聯合目標進行優化，無需訪問代理的模型。在 AgentDrift 基準的任務不重疊拆分（12,536 條軌跡，71,024 個標記步驟）中，通過 20 個配置的掃描將超參數敏感性限制在 0.011 F1，測試部分僅評估一次，DriftNet 達到軌跡級 F1 為 0.983，對 98.7% 被攻擊軌跡的精確注入點恢復，劫持跨度 IoU 為 0.979，對 218 次抵抗攻擊的零標記，以及對困難負樣本的 2.9% 標記。重新訓練在相同拆分上的表面基線恢復了 11.1% 的部分劫持和 17.1% 的延遲執行；DriftNet 達到 98.6% 和 93.2%，同時降低每個誤報率。閱讀所有 26 個殘餘錯誤顯示，大多數漏檢追溯到標記的注入觀察未包含可讀指令的軌跡，我們報告基準測量的世界身份規律性及其結果。
2609.10892.author: Asif Pinjari et.al.
